status: declared by the pull request that closes #482 before anything was computed; reported only, nothing here changes the judge's declaration, a tier, a cut-off rule or any published figure; the choices below are the pull request's, listed there for Eleonora's review

rows.source: docs/pivot/onset-diagnostics-result.md, the five tier-1 rows (metadata/onset_diagnostics.json, false_alarms.rows.chosen)

year_dominance.share_of_all_days: the period's scored days over all scored days, 2018-06-29 to 2025-12-31 (an after-the-fact quantity: this is a sensitivity reading, not a rule)
year_dominance.weights: in each refit's training window, every day of the period weighs the same and the period's days together weigh the period's share of all days; days outside it weigh 1; a window with days on one side only weighs every day 1. Onsets, caught onsets and false alarms of the cut-off choice are counted at their day's weight; the limit (2.0 false alarms per onset) and the tie rule are the declared ones
year_dominance.calibration: the probabilities are the rows' own and are not refitted; calibration is read pooled over the scored days with the period's days at the same weights, and by regime unchanged (weights are constant within a regime)
year_dominance.by_year: tier 1 (onsets, onsets flagged at some horizon, worst false alarms per onset) and tier 3 (flags per 252 days over all days; calibration by regime) read in calendar years, beside the declared reading

refit_cadence.reading: the flag cut-off is refitted every k scored days instead of the declared 21 (cutoff_rule.refit_every); the rows' probabilities, which their own scripts refit every 21 scored days, are unchanged

week_ahead_combiner.reading: tier 5 for each row and benchmark with the five horizons' probabilities combined by the maximum (declared) and by independence (one minus the product of one minus each probability)

tier_3_coverage.reading: the calibration table (mean predicted, realised, difference with its 90% interval, covers zero) in every regime, including those with no pressure day, at each horizon; with the alarm rate per year in the abundant stretches
